title: Pasta carbonara
description: Spaghetti with crisp bacon, egg yolks and parmesan, made creamy with a splash of pasta water. No cream needed.
steps: Cook the spaghetti in salted water. Fry the diced bacon in a dry pan until crisp.
Whisk the eggs with the grated parmesan and plenty of pepper.
Keep a cup of pasta water, drain, and toss the pasta with the bacon off the heat.
Pour in the egg mix with a splash of pasta water and stir quickly until creamy, not scrambled.

title: Egg fried rice with peas
description: Day-old rice fried hot with eggs, peas, carrot and spring onion. The best way to use leftover rice.
steps: Heat the oil in a wok until very hot. Stir-fry the diced carrot and garlic for 2 minutes, then the peas.
Push everything aside, scramble the beaten eggs in the space, then mix in.
Add the cold rice and stir-fry 4 minutes, pressing it against the pan.
Season with soy sauce and sesame oil and toss with the spring onion.

title: Tuna and tomato pasta
description: A store-cupboard pasta with canned tuna, tomatoes, capers and olives. On the table in 20 minutes.
steps: Cook the pasta. Warm the garlic and chili in the oil for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, capers and olives and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in the drained tuna and heat through.
Toss with the pasta and parsley.

title: Bean and cheese quesadillas
description: Crisp tortillas filled with mashed beans, corn, pepper and melted cheese, with a quick tomato salsa.
steps: Mash the drained beans with the cumin. Dice the pepper.
Spread beans on half of each tortilla, add corn, pepper and grated cheese and fold over.
Toast in a dry pan 2 to 3 minutes a side until crisp and melted.
Chop the tomato and onion with lemon juice and a pinch of salt and serve with the quesadillas and salad.

title: Chicken fajita wraps
description: Sizzling spiced chicken with peppers and onions in warm tortillas with sour cream and salsa.
steps: Slice the chicken, peppers and onion into strips and toss with the spices, salt and oil.
Fry in a very hot pan for 8 to 10 minutes until the chicken is cooked and the vegetables are charred.
Squeeze over the lemon and warm the tortillas.
Wrap the filling with sour cream and salsa.

title: Garlic prawn linguine
description: Prawns tossed with garlic, chili, lemon and parsley through linguine. Feels special, takes 20 minutes.
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water.
Warm the sliced garlic and chili in the oil until just golden. Add the prawns and cook 3 minutes until pink.
Add the halved tomatoes, the lemon juice and a ladle of pasta water.
Toss with the drained pasta and parsley.

title: Pad Thai-style noodles
description: Rice noodles with egg, tofu, crunchy cabbage and peanuts in a sweet, sour and salty sauce.
steps: Soak or cook the noodles as the packet says. Mix the soy, ketchup, sugar and lime juice.
Fry the cubed tofu in the oil until golden, push aside and scramble the eggs.
Add the shredded cabbage and carrot for 2 minutes, then the noodles and sauce. Toss until coated.
Serve with chopped peanuts and spring onion.

title: Quick chicken ramen
description: A fast noodle soup with ginger and soy broth, sliced chicken, soft-boiled egg, spinach and spring onion.
steps: Simmer 1.5 litres of water with the stock cube, sliced ginger, garlic and soy for 10 minutes. Poach the chicken in it for 10 minutes, then slice.
Boil the eggs for 6.5 minutes, cool in cold water and peel.
Add the sliced mushrooms and noodles to the broth and cook as the noodle packet says. Stir in the spinach.
Serve in bowls with the chicken, halved eggs, spring onion and a few drops of sesame oil.

title: Gnocchi with tomato and mozzarella
description: Pan-fried gnocchi in a quick tomato and basil sauce with melting mozzarella. Kids love it.
steps: Fry the gnocchi in the oil for 6 to 8 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic, then the passata, basil and spinach, and simmer 5 minutes.
Tear the mozzarella over the top, cover and cook 3 minutes until melted.
Serve with grated parmesan.

title: Spaghetti aglio e olio with spinach and egg
description: Garlic, olive oil and chili spaghetti with wilted spinach and a fried egg on top. Fifteen minutes.
steps: Cook the spaghetti in salted water.
Gently warm the sliced garlic and chili in 4 tbsp oil until pale golden. Add the spinach to wilt.
Fry the eggs in the rest of the oil.
Toss the pasta with the garlic oil, spinach, a splash of pasta water and parmesan. Top each plate with an egg.

title: 15-minute chickpea and spinach curry
description: Chickpeas and spinach in a quick coconut tomato curry, served with flatbread or rice.
steps: Fry the chopped onion in the oil for 5 minutes, add the garlic and curry powder.
Add the tomatoes, coconut milk, drained chickpeas and salt and simmer 8 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted.
Serve with warm flatbread.

title: Couscous salad with feta and chickpeas
description: Lemony couscous with chickpeas, cucumber, tomato, roasted peppers, feta and parsley. Good for lunch boxes.
steps: Pour 300 ml boiling water over the couscous with the salt, cover for 5 minutes and fluff with a fork.
Dice the cucumber, tomato and peppers and chop the parsley.
Mix everything with the drained chickpeas, lemon juice and oil.
Crumble the feta over the top.

title: Turkey and pepper wraps with yogurt
description: Strips of turkey breast fried with peppers and paprika, wrapped with lettuce and garlic yogurt.
steps: Slice the turkey, peppers and onion into strips. Toss with paprika and salt.
Fry in the oil on high heat for 8 to 10 minutes.
Mix the yogurt with the crushed garlic.
Fill the warm tortillas with lettuce, turkey and peppers and a spoon of yogurt.

title: Pan-fried salmon with lemon couscous
description: Crisp-skinned salmon with herby lemon couscous and garlicky spinach. Ready in 25 minutes.
steps: Pour 300 ml boiling water over the couscous with half the salt and 1 tbsp oil. Cover for 5 minutes, then fluff with lemon juice and parsley.
Season the salmon and fry skin side down in 1 tbsp oil for 5 minutes, turn and cook 2 to 3 minutes more.
Wilt the spinach with the garlic in the rest of the oil.
Serve the salmon on the couscous with the spinach.

title: Ćevapi in flatbread with ajvar and onion
description: Grilled ćevapi in warm lepinja with chopped onion, ajvar and a fresh cabbage and tomato salad.
steps: Grill or pan-fry the ćevapi for 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through.
Warm the flatbread on the grill or in the pan with the meat juices.
Shred the cabbage, slice the tomatoes and dress with vinegar, oil and a pinch of salt.
Fill the bread with ćevapi, chopped onion and ajvar and serve with the salad.

title: Cheese and herb omelette with salad
description: Fluffy omelettes with grated cheese and herbs, served with tomato salad and bread. Ten minutes per pan.
steps: Beat the eggs with salt and the chopped parsley.
Melt half the butter in a pan, pour in half the eggs and stir gently until almost set.
Scatter with half the cheese, fold and slide onto a plate. Repeat.
Serve with sliced tomato and cucumber dressed with oil, and bread.

title: Halloumi and roasted pepper flatbreads
description: Golden grilled halloumi with roasted peppers, hummus and salad in warm flatbread.
steps: Slice the halloumi and dry-fry 2 minutes a side until golden.
Warm the flatbreads.
Spread with hummus and fill with lettuce, sliced tomato, peppers and halloumi.
Squeeze over a little lemon and roll up.

title: Tortellini with peas and ham
description: Cheese tortellini in a light cream sauce with peas, ham and parmesan. Ten minutes from start to plate.
steps: Cook the tortellini as the packet says, adding the peas for the last 2 minutes.
Warm the diced ham in a pan, add the cream and pepper and bubble 2 minutes.
Toss with the drained tortellini and peas.
Serve with parmesan.

title: Tuna and white bean salad
description: No-cook salad of tuna, beans, red onion, tomatoes and parsley with a mustard dressing. Bread on the side.
steps: Slice the onion thinly and soak it in the vinegar for 5 minutes.
Whisk the mustard and oil into the vinegar.
Mix the drained beans, tuna, chopped tomatoes, onion and parsley with the dressing.
Serve with bread.

title: Penne arrabbiata with chickpeas
description: Fiery tomato and garlic penne made more filling with chickpeas. Vegan and very cheap.
steps: Cook the penne in salted water.
Warm the garlic and chili in the oil, add the tomatoes and simmer 12 minutes.
Add the drained chickpeas and heat through.
Toss with the pasta and parsley.
